name: Honk Lord
title: Menace of the Village
description: An absolutely unhinged goose. Honks. Summons goslings. Becomes enormous.

passive.name: Agent of Chaos
passive.short_description: Basic attacks can randomly stun, slow, knock back, or deal bonus true damage.
passive.description: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to trigger one of four equally likely effects: stun for 0.75s, slow by 60% for 1.5s, knock back 220 units, or deal 40 + 50% AD bonus true damage.

q.name: HONK
q.short_description: Damage and knock back enemies with a honk.
q.description: Honk in a 70-degree cone, dealing 55 + 50% AD magic damage and knocking enemies back 260 units over 0.3s.

w.name: Goslings
w.short_description: Summon goslings to chase and attack enemies.
w.description: Summon 3 goslings for 10s. Each has 120 + 15 per level HP, 10 + 2 per level attack damage, 1.2 attacks per second, and 390 move speed.

e.name: Egg Bomb
e.short_description: Lob an egg that damages and slows enemies where it lands.
e.description: After 0.7s, the egg lands and hits enemies within 170 for 80 + 40% AD magic damage, slowing them by 50% for 1.5s.

r.name: GOOSE MODE
r.short_description: Turn into a giant goose, gain stats, and damage nearby enemies.
r.description: For 7s, gain 90% size, 50% attack damage, 25% move speed, and 30% max HP. Enemies within 230 take 15 + 10% AD magic damage every 0.5s.
